senses.gloss: esp. pounded beans; beans used for pounding.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 94:2">Gen. R. s. 94</cite>, beg.; <cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 9:6">Nidd. IX, 6</cite> sq.; <cite ref="Tosefta Niddah 8:9">Tosef. ib. VIII, 9</cite>, v. <cite ref="H01010"><he>חֲלוּקָה</he></cite> a. <cite ref="U01640"><he>שְׁעוּעִית</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 5:8">Maasr. V, 8</cite> <he>ג׳ הקלקין</he> Cilician beans.

Tosef. ib. III, 14 [read:] אילו הן ג׳ הקלקין (אילו) הַגַּסִּין המרובעין (v. Maim. a. R. S. to Maasr. l. c.) Cilician beans are the large and quadrangular; a. fr. [גריסות, v. גָּרוֹסָה.]—כג׳ the size of a bean. Sifra Thazr.
Neg. ch. I. Kel. XVII, 1Kel. XVII, 12 ג׳ נגעים כג׳ וכ׳ the garis as a standard for eruptions is the Cilician bean.

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 2:2">Koh. R. to II, 2</cite>; Tanḥ. Aḥaré 1, a. e. <he>קערה של ג׳</he> a dish of boiled grit; <cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 5:6">Ruth R. to II, 14</cite> <he>גְּרִישִׂין</he>. [<cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 2:15">Ib. to II, 15</cite> <he>היה מבקר גרישין</he>, read with <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 604:3">Yalk. ib. 604</cite> <he>גְּדִישִׁין</he>, v. <cite ref="C00219"><he>גָּדִישׁ</he></cite>.]
